title: Teach value two more ops
hints: Copy the two `mul` lines twice and change them, once for `sub` and once for `max`. Put the new lines above the `raise` line, which must stay last.
`a` and `b` are already plain numbers by the time you reach your new lines. `sub` takes the second source away from the first: `return a - b`.
Python has a built-in `max`: `if n.op == "max": return max(a, b)`.

answer.explain: The reference adds two branches above the `raise`: `sub` returns `a - b` and `max` returns `max(a, b)`. By then `a` and `b` are plain numbers, because `value` has already called itself on both sources. The order matters for `sub`: the first source is on the left.
